chapters.label: The steal
chapters.text: Hampden Park, 2023. Scotland against Spain. A Spain defender slips by the goal line. Andy Robertson steals the ball and cuts it back, and Scott McTominay scores!

chapters.label: The late run
chapters.text: Watch McTominay. He times his run into the middle of the box, and gets there just as the ball does. First time, left foot!

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: The low shot flicks off a defender on the ground and past the keeper. Goal!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That is the late run and finish. Time your run so you arrive in the box just as the ball does!
